'''James Weaver Clark''' is a voice actor for the English dub of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Clark is an American voice actor. He joined {{aniseries|PTS}} during {{aniseries|XY}}, voicing several Pokémon in the [[Hoopa's Surprise Ring Adventures]] shorts before joining the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|SM}} as [[Mad Magmar]]. In 2017, he married fellow voice actor [[Alyson Leigh Rosenfeld]], who also works on ''Pokémon the Series''.
